title: Figure 13: Lab setup for 2-beam/2-detector interferometric measurement with result plots
description: Left: color photograph of an optical bench with mounted mirrors and optics, annotated with red dashed beam paths and labels "BS", "Adjustment Mirror" and "Delay Line". Right: two plots of normalized detector signal (red and black lines) versus delay line position in microns, labeled as interference scans at different wavelengths. Caption: "Figure 13. (Left): Experimental Setup for 2-Beams/2-Detectors Interferometric Measurement in Our Lab. (Right): Preliminary Experimental Results." Measurements noted at λ = 10.8 um and λ = 11.3 um.
